errors.error_description: Declared a logic vector 'dbg_unused' that is never read or driven anywhere in the design.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same clocked always block by assigning 'done = 1'b0' (blocking) while also assigning 'done <= 1'b1' later (non-blocking).
Declared a signal using an escaped identifier '\logic', which uses the reserved keyword 'logic' as an identifier.
